items.html: And after ZA returned to his first measure, with only six extremities, his eyes and eyelids closed, and he could not gaze and shine in the Nukva as at first; and also the observation of Arich Anpin in him was taken away from him. And corresponding to the departure of the light of the eyes of AA from him, he said "Who causes the bands of sleep to fall upon my eyes," for through the lack of the supernal observation upon him, sleep fell upon his eyes. And from this it follows that he too removed his light and his providence from the Nukva, and closed his eyes with his eyelids, and did not look upon her. And corresponding to this he said "and slumber upon my eyelids."
